template.title: Tell chat about ad breaks
template.description: When Twitch says an ad break began, says so in chat; when it should be over, welcomes everyone back. The end is an estimate: Twitch doesn't say when ads end. Ads need an Affiliate or Partner channel.

with.message: A ${event.payload.duration_seconds}-second ad break is starting. Thanks for sticking around, back soon! 📺
The ads should be over now. Welcome back! 👋
